title: Kuriruputá y las manos que lo sostienen
palette: Ochre and warm sand paper ground, muted terracotta shirt, mustard/burgundy/indigo sisters, a small deep rust-red tuma. DRY daylight except explicitly designated indoor dream, whose shadows are muted blue-grey. Blue is never an instruction to add rain. No gold, glow or glitter.
story_thesis: La fuerza que permite volver no es la de un hombre solo: rescatar, escuchar y reconstruir también cambian una historia.
shared_scene_continuity: ALL CHARACTERS are nearly FLAT paper silhouettes with contour-profile noses, tiny cut eyes, and NO faceted/sculpted heads.
Full figures in middle distance, normally 18–25% image height; foreground is paper landscape, never a face or cropped body.
Only entities listed for this shot may appear. Historical clothing continuity, no clan symbols or facial patterns.
All ground is broad THIN overlapping paper sheets with narrow air gaps and shadows, never cracked soil. Sparse plants only thin cut-paper thorn tree silhouettes and columnar cardon if present.
A cream cloth-path and rust-red stone-paths are audiovisual metaphors, NOT traditional symbols or literal documented miracles. Keep air between layers to the final shot.
continuity_rules: Camisa terracota de manga larga, pantalón crudo hasta tobillo, cabello negro a nuca, sandalias oscuras en Kuriruputá.
Tres hermanas como reparto de arte: mayor mostaza/cabello gris; adulta burdeos/negro largo; adulta índigo/negro largo. Mantas hasta tobillos, sin estampados.
Paño limpio rodea rodilla izquierda DESDE rescate hasta mediación: lado editorial, no dato histórico. Sin lesión visible ni sangre.
Nueva pareja adulta manta azul gris con paneles arena y trenza negra lateral, distinta de hermana índigo; voz propia en cierre, no premio ni objeto entregado.
Las reses son ganado vacuno, no sustituir por chivos del modelo compartido. Tres vacas distintas visibles cuando el plano requiere ganado: crema, parda y arena.
El sueño se distingue por espacio interior y capas suspendidas; no afirmar que el objeto real cura o da órdenes.
Tomas separadas por cortes; no solicitar morph ni asumir capas editables dentro de JPEG.

events.description: Hermanas y hermano interpretan juntos la visión.
Se discuten animales, daños y responsabilidades sin solución total inmediata.
Nueva unión y continuidad familiar, con agencia de la pareja según lectura publicada.
Reconocer a hermanas y recordar la historia sin glorificar invencibilidad.

inventory.desc: ADULT WAYUU MAN, short nape-length black hair, plain TERRACOTTA LONG-SLEEVE SHIRT, full ankle-length CREAM TROUSERS, dark sandals, no hat, no necklace. Almost-flat profile cut from thin paper, NO facial volume. Clean left-knee cloth ONLY when scene explicitly requests it.

THREE adult sisters with full ankle-length loose plain MANTAS and dark sandals: elderly woman MUSTARD with long GREY hair, middle adult BURGUNDY with long BLACK hair, adult INDIGO with long BLACK hair. Hair is hair-shaped flat cut paper, not a veil. No paint or ornaments. Separate silhouettes with clear gestures, almost-flat paper profiles.

ADULT WOMAN, long opaque BLUE-GREY ankle-length manta with broad SAND side panels, black SIDE BRAID over shoulder, dark sandals. Nearly flat cut-paper profile. Distinct from dark-indigo sister. Active equal participant, no bridal veil, jewelry, ceremony or object-exchange.

ONE adult male relative: plain long-sleeve SAND shirt, full CHARCOAL trousers, short black hair and dark sandals, flat paper profile. No hat, weapon, staff, facial paint or ceremonial insignia. Editorial supporting character, not named historical person.

ONE adult woman from the other household, long plain OLIVE ankle-length manta, black low bun and dark sandals, flat paper profile. No staff, ritual garments, necklace or clan signs. Editorial interlocutor, not certified palabrero.

THREE anonymous distant adult silhouettes, complete sand/grey shirts and charcoal full trousers; small flat profiles without caricature, face paint, ethnicity markers or demon traits. Represent only the particular adversaries of this story; no individual from another myth reused.

THREE distinct full cattle silhouettes: one cream, one chestnut-brown, one sand. Broad almost-flat cut-paper bodies, simple short horns, thin legs, complete hooves and tails, no fur or folded faceted sculpture. Each on a separate depth offset, space around each; no goats, sheep or horses.

Dry low Guajira plain, gentle ochre paper ridges far away. Wide overlapping flat paper-ground sheets; sparse thin-cut thorn-tree silhouettes and occasional straight columnar cardon. No high jagged mountains, ocean or agave rosettes automatically inherited.

Same simple rectangular cattle enclosure, thin flat vertical paper stakes and two narrow horizontal paper rails, plain side gate. Open gate only when requested. All structures thin paper, not round wood. No ornamental design or writing.

Same low simple dwelling: muted ochre thin-paper walls, low sloping sand strip-paper roof, one doorway and adjacent shaded open work area. Paper posts, no stone/wood realism, no miniature box exterior. Interior floor continues into landscape.

ONE long plain CREAM PAPER CLOTH, soft broad bends between thin sheets, no embroidery, red stains or rope. A small separate clean cream strip around protagonist LEFT KNEE over trousers in rescue/recovery; no wound. In specified magical shot only, long cloth extends into a path; never a corpse shroud.

ONE small PALM-SIZED irregular rounded deep RUST-RED TUMA, assembled from a few thin matte red paper contours; NOT a huge rock, faceted ruby, ornament, heart, amulet, glowing crystal or levitating face. Never in anyone's mouth. Strips extend from it ONLY in explicitly magical scene.
ONE plain rectangular sand paper mat resting flush on ground, not raised bench or pedestal; no symbols. Only for sitting or reclining.

Historical long rifles rendered as small simple flat dark PAPER silhouettes, carried LOW muzzle toward ground, no firing, aiming at people, shells, blast, blood or handling instruction. Present only in defense aftermath shot; no combat pictured.
Small paired hoof impressions as flat shadow-shaped paper cutouts leading away from corral; never blood trails, text or iconographic code.

Two or three narrow rust-red PAPER PATHS physically unfolding from layers of a small red stone, hovering slightly above ground with shadows and returning toward distinct household thresholds. Broad quiet curves, not rays, roots, strings around bodies or traditional motifs.

notes: Ocho modelos y tres trípticos inspeccionados directamente en este turno; hashes verificados por preparador.
Conservar identidad, ropa, paleta y relaciones del tríptico. No heredar terreno granular, caras facetadas, madera ni volumen de animales de Biblia.
La ficha grupal de rebaños incluye caprinos; el episodio pide vacunos, se explicita selección de especie antes de producir.
No subir originales al proveedor: investigación visual solamente.
Tres hermanas, lado del paño y reparto de mediación son decisiones de continuidad, no reconstrucciones históricas certificadas.

blocks.voice_over: Una mañana, Kuriruputá encontró huellas junto al corral. Faltaban animales. Sus hermanas le pidieron prudencia, pero él reunió a sus parientes y salió a buscar lo perdido.
blocks.voice_provenance: Versión publicada: mañana y parientes; no trasladar literalmente la cronología nocturna del registro histórico.

blocks.voice_over: El encuentro terminó en combate. Kuriruputá cayó herido y sus compañeros retrocedieron. Sus hermanas salieron a buscarlo. Cuando llegaron, fueron ellas quienes sostuvieron la defensa y consiguieron el regreso.
blocks.voice_provenance: Elipsis no gráfica del conflicto y rescate; secuencia de compañeros según relato publicado. No representar disparos ni lesiones.

motion_contract.camera: Movimiento lento opcional por definir tras aprobar originales.
